answer: Random transcript audit works like a spot re-inspection: each epoch the chain samples one past answer and demands the author re-derive it live under a fresh nonce, so a copied reply is a dead relic. A withheld pre-computed answer fails instantly, since the nonce arrives after the fact. Two mismatches quarantine that identity to a sealed island of manual review and freeze its emission. Passing costs each agent roughly 0.04 dollars in re-derivation compute, while faking 10000 identities burns 400 dollars per epoch for nectar-level returns.
